audience: Owners and estimators at CNC machine shops and job shops
headline: RFQs still take days to quote?
symptoms: Every RFQ waits for one person to read the drawing
Hours come from memory, and nobody checks quote vs actual
Won jobs get retyped into the traveler and inspection sheet
build: An RFQ desk that reads each drawing, flags what drives cost, and suggests hours from similar jobs you already ran, so quotes go out in hours, not days. A won quote becomes the traveler and inspection plan, and actual hours sharpen the next estimate. The estimator approves every price.

screens.caption: New RFQ lands in the inbox, due in 2 days
Drawing read in 38 seconds, cost risks flagged
Hours suggested from similar jobs you ran
Quote sent in 4 hours instead of 3 days
Quote vs actual sharpens the next estimate
